༄༅/ /dzab khang dbye ba ni/oṃ sarba dz+nyā na dhā ki ni maṇ+ḍa la s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa:ces pas rang 'dra'i dkyil 'khor gnyis pa spro:saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐:zhes pas mdun

tei:div.tei:p: oṃ sarba dz+nyā na dhā ki ni maṇ+ḍa la s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa: ces pas rang 'dra'i dkyil 'khor gnyis pa spro: saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: zhes pas mdun rten dang dbyer med du bzhugs par gyur: hūm̐: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho sogs/ dzab bskul ni/ hūm̐: dbus kyi phyogs nas rang byung grub pa'i lha: bcom ldan khyab bdag bde chen khros ma nag: bzlas pa'i phrin las g.yel med mdzad nas kyang : mchog thun dngos grub ye shes char du phob: rtsa sngags/ hūm̐: phyogs bzhi'i gnas nas rang = bcom ldan las kyi mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi'i tshogs: bzlas pa phrin las= mchog thun dngos grub= rigs bzhi'i sngags/ hūm̐: 'khor lo gsum nas rang = gnas yul nyer bzhi'i dpa' bo rnam 'byor ma: bzlas pa'i phrin las= mchog thun dngos grub= sku gsung thugs sngags/ hūm̐: sgo bzhi mtshams bzhir rang = phra men las byed mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams kun: bzlas pa'i phrin las g.yel med mdzad nas kyang : mchog thun dngos grub ye shes char du phob: las dang dam tshig mkha' 'gro'i sngags/ ༈ thod bum sgrub pa ni/ bhan+dha'i snod du dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas khang du bcud ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor 'khyil pa'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje khros ma nag mo/ phyogs bzhir snying po'i mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi/ de rgyab gnas yul gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ phra man dang dam tshig gi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dwangs ba'i mtsho la zla skar shar ba bzhin skad cig gis gsal bar gyur/ gzungs thag blangs la/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'od zer gzungs thag la 'khril te lha rnams la phog pas bde ba chen po'i rjes chags bskul/ byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi ye shes kyi bcud du 'khyil par gyur/ lha sngags rnams cung zad re bzlas/ dzab dbyangs/ dgongs pa bskyangs la hūm̐ blu blang*/ dbyangs gsal rten snying yig brgya rnams lan gsum re bzla/ mchod bstod nongs bshags bcas byas la/

lha rnams bde ba chen po'i ngo bor 'od du zhu nas thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang dbyer med gyur/ ༈ /tshogs bsgral ba'i skabs/ oṃ saḥkarma dhā kī ni badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nām̐ sha trun mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa: rang nyid rdo rje khros ma'i skur gyur/ na mo sogs 'gugs pa lan gcig dang*/ sgo bzhi'i sngags rgya brjod cing g.yab rol sogs mthong rgyud ltar bya/ slob dpon gyis phur bu thogs la// //
